name: Audio Studio
description: AI audio production chain: turn a topic or document into a segmented podcast script (spoken words only - TTS reads everything), direct voice synthesis with a voice catalog and per-character casting, and publish with shownotes, timestamped chapters, and platform metadata. Topic in, publishable episode out, no step left dangling.
description_zh: AI 音频生产链条：把选题或文档变成分段播客脚本（纯口播词——TTS 会把一切都读出来），按声音目录做角色选声与合成参数执导，并以 shownotes、时间戳章节、平台元数据收尾发布。选题进、可发布节目出，链条不断头。方法论借鉴 Kokoro/Qwen3-TTS 生态与 Podify/inference.sh 实践并已署名。
